name: Hirono (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hirono town emblem in navy: a stylised swirl like a letter G with a horizontal bar.
history: Municipal flag of Hirono, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1972.

features.role: Hirono town emblem — a stylised swirl like a letter G with a horizontal bar
